headline: Minister Şimşek's Assessment of Growth
summary: Treasury and Finance Minister Mehmet Şimşek said Türkiye's economy grew 2.3% annually and 1.1% quarterly in the second quarter of 2026, with domestic and foreign demand both contributing.
why: Gross domestic product growth signals the health of an economy and shapes central bank policy, sovereign credit assessments and investor sentiment.
